description: Action Receipts: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained attestation of an agent-reported action and status; not evidence the action happened or a legal compliance certification. Per caller and agent chain; concurrent appends serialize with compare-and-set. Raw action/reference are hashed, not stored. event_id per agent is the authoritative idempotency key; a custom HTTP key cannot override it. Same event_id/body returns the same receipt; changed body conflicts. GET /v1/receipt/verify?id=<receipt_id> is free and returns the receipt to anyone who knows its unguessable ID. Or pass receipt=<JSON> to verify a portable receipt. Keep IDs private if your agent IDs/status are sensitive. Records persist until the API key is deleted; keyless records have no automatic expiry. $0.003 per call; shared 3 free calls per UTC day without a key (daily private IP namespace), plus 10/day with a free key. Anonymous scopes rotate daily; use a key for a persistent ledger/chain. Send the same Bearer key plus a payment header to keep the same ledger/chain after the allowance runs out.
